_meta.avertissement: Jeu de donnees pedagogique reconstitue a partir des grandes lignes du programme officiel, a vocation de demonstration. Ce n'est pas le texte officiel : toute conclusion tiree de cette version est bornee par cette approximation.
_meta.provenance: Publiee depuis 1.0-reconstitue : perimetre recentre sur les mathematiques seules (retrait du francais et des sciences) et ajout du niveau « Derniere annee du college ».

Mathématiques - Dernière année du primai.referentiel: Common Core State Standards — Grade 5 Mathematics

notions.descriptif: Recognise that a digit represents ten times what it represents to its right, read and round decimals to thousandths.
Fluently multiply multi-digit numbers and divide with two-digit divisors using place value strategies.

notions.intitule: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators
notions.descriptif: Use equivalent fractions to add and subtract fractions, including mixed numbers, and solve word problems.
Interpret fractions as division, multiply a fraction by a whole number or a fraction, divide unit fractions.
Add, subtract, multiply and divide decimals using concrete models and written strategies.

notions.intitule: Numerical expressions and order of operations
notions.descriptif: Write and interpret numerical expressions with parentheses, brackets and braces, and evaluate them.

notions.intitule: Patterns and relationships between two rules
notions.descriptif: Generate two numerical patterns, form ordered pairs and graph them on a coordinate plane.
Use the first quadrant of the coordinate plane to represent real-world and mathematical problems.
Understand volume as an attribute, count unit cubes and apply the formulas V = l x w x h and V = b x h.
Convert among different-sized standard measurement units within a system and use them in multi-step problems.
Classify shapes into hierarchies based on properties, understanding that attributes of a category are shared.

notions.intitule: Represent and interpret data with line plots
notions.descriptif: Make a line plot with fractional measurement units and use operations on fractions to answer questions.

Mathématiques - Dernière année du collèg.referentiel: Common Core State Standards — Grade 8 Mathematics

notions.descriptif: Know that numbers that are not rational are irrational, approximate them by rationals and locate them approximately on a number line.
Apply the properties of integer exponents, evaluate square and cube roots, and use scientific notation to estimate and compare quantities.
Graph proportional relationships, interpret the unit rate as the slope and compare two proportional relationships represented in different ways.
Solve linear equations with rational coefficients, including those requiring expansion, and identify equations with one, infinitely many or no solutions.
Solve pairs of simultaneous linear equations algebraically and by graphing, and interpret the point of intersection in context.
Understand a function as a rule assigning exactly one output to each input, and compare functions given algebraically, graphically or in tables.
Construct a linear function to model a relationship between two quantities and interpret its rate of change and initial value in context.
Verify the properties of rotations, reflections and translations and describe sequences of transformations mapping one figure onto another.
Establish similarity through dilations and use angle sums, exterior angles and the angle-angle criterion for similar triangles.
Explain a proof of the theorem and its converse and apply it in two and three dimensions and to find distances in the coordinate plane.

notions.intitule: Volume of cylinders, cones and spheres
notions.descriptif: Know and apply the formulas for the volume of cylinders, cones and spheres to solve real-world and mathematical problems.

notions.intitule: Bivariate data and patterns of association
notions.descriptif: Construct and interpret scatter plots, informally fit a straight line and use two-way tables to investigate association in categorical data.
